content.what_it_is: MATLAB plotting script that loads reference data from C.mat (line 2) and seven station series (lines 4-10), shifts and rescales their first columns (lines 14-21), scales seven loaded g-series by 100 over 600 elements (lines 35-42), vertically offsets six paired series (lines 47-63), and overlays all seven computed/reference pairs on one Case C plot (lines 69-106).
entities: script workspace cleared by clear all @L1
C.mat variables imported into the workspace @L2
plot axes state changed by hold on @L70

equations.expr: n4(i,1)=n4(i,1)/10.+shift (and identically for n5 through n10)
equations.ref: station first-column rescaling and horizontal shift

equations.expr: g4(i)=g4(i)*100 (and identically for g5 through g10)

equations.ref: first plotted pair receives six vertical spacings
second plotted pair receives five vertical spacings
third plotted pair receives four vertical spacings
fourth plotted pair receives three vertical spacings
fifth plotted pair receives two vertical spacings
sixth plotted pair receives one vertical spacing

unresolved: Use-before-local-assignment / implicit interface: g4 through g10 are first referenced on lines 36-42 and t is first referenced on line 69; their only possible source in this file is the unstructured workspace import load('C.mat') on line 2, so their presence, shapes, and correspondence cannot be established from the script.

Range coupling: both loops use length(n4) as the bound (lines 14 and 25) while indexing n5 through n10 on lines 16-21 and 27-32; any shorter station array causes out-of-range indexing, and extra rows in longer arrays are left untransformed.

Range coupling: lines 35-42 index every g-series at 1:600 without checking that g4 through g10 each contain at least 600 elements; later plot calls on lines 69-99 additionally require each g-series length to match t.
Copy/paste no-op: the complete loop on lines 25-33 assigns every second column element to itself and has no effect.

Cross-series transform asymmetry: n4/g4 through n9/g9 receive paired vertical offsets on lines 47-63, but the analogous n10/g10 offset statements are commented on lines 65-66 while that pair is still plotted on lines 99-101; whether the unshifted final pair is intentional is not stated.

The loaded station first columns are divided by 10 and shifted (lines 15-21) while loaded g amplitudes are multiplied by 100 (lines 36-42); the source units of the imported arrays are not declared in this file, so the plotted axis labels cannot independently validate these conversions.
